section_summary.extract_value: This section presents an exploratory theoretical model examining relationships between caregiver eating messages, attachment styles, perfectionism, body appreciation, and depressive symptoms in predicting intuitive eating. The author outlines hypothesized paths based on prior research, proposing that body appreciation may mediate links from interpersonal and intrapersonal variables to both depression and intuitive eating, and notes that the model will be tested while remaining open to trimming non-significant paths and adding unanticipated paths that substantially improve model fit.
